arabic text: AY SHIMR ZARA\nYE CHOTI ZAHRA HAI\nKUCH REHM TO KHA
english translation text: O SHIMR, HAVE SOME MERCY, THIS IS A LITTLE ZAHRA

arabic text: MASOOM SAKINA HAI
english translation text: THIS IS THE INNOCENT SAKINA

arabic text: NA MAAR ISSE\nNAZON SE ISSE\nSHABBIR NE PAALA HAI
english translation text: DON’T HIT HER, WITH GREAT LOVE AND CARE, HUSSAIN HAS BROUGHT HER UP

arabic text: SAJJAD KI BEHNA KO\nGHAZI KI BHATIJI KO
english translation text: THE SISTER OF SAJJAD\nTHE NIECE OF ABBAS

arabic text: MANGA HAI KANEEZI ME\nIS PHOOL SI BACHI KO
english translation text: THEY HAVE TREATED THIS LITTLE GIRL LIKE A SLAVE

arabic text: SHEH NE APNE\nSAJDO ME ISSE ALLAH SE MANGA HAI
english translation text: THE ONE WHO HUSSAIN USED TO PRAY FOR

arabic text: DORENGE AGAR NAQE\nKIS TARHA SAMBHLEGI
english translation text: WHEN THE CAMELS GO FAST, HOW WILL SHE HANDLE THIS?

arabic text: AWAAZ KISSE DEGI\nGAR RAAH ME GIR JAAYE
english translation text: IF SHE FALLS ON THE ROAD, WHO WILL SHE CALL OUT TO?

arabic text: PUSHTE NAQA PER KYUN TANHA\nRASSI SE BANDHA HAI
english translation text: WHY HAVE YOU TIED HER ALONE WITH ROPES ON THE CAMEL

arabic text: KYA JURM KIYA ISNE\nKYUN ISKO RULATA HAI
english translation text: WHAT HAS SHE DONE WRONG, WHY DO YOU MAKE HER CRY

arabic text: DIKHLA KE ISSE PAANI\nMATTI PE BAHATA HAI
english translation text: YOU SHOW HER WATER, THEN SPILL IT ON THE FLOOR

arabic text: KYA TERI KOI AWLAD NAHI\nKYUN ZULM YE DHATA HAI
english translation text: DO YOU NOT HAVE A FAMILY? WHY DO YOU OPPRESS LIKE THIS?

arabic text: RONE NA DIYA ISKO\nBABA KE LAASHE PER
english translation text: YOU DIDN’T LET HER CRY AT HER FATHER’S GRAVE

arabic text: HAI NEEL TAMACHO KE MASUMA KE CHEHRE PER
english translation text: HER CHEEKS ARE RED FROM THE MARKS OF THE SLAPS!

arabic text: ALLAH JAANE\nYEH ISPE SITAM\nKIS BAAT KA BADLA HAI
english translation text: ONLY GOD KNOWS, ALL THIS TORTURE – WHAT ARE THEY AVENGING

arabic text: EK RAAT SARE ZINDAAN\nSHABBIR KA SAR AYA
english translation text: ONE NIGHT IN THE PRISON OF SHAAM THE HEAD OF HUSSAIN WAS BROUGHT

arabic text: BACHI NE KIYA NOHA\nSAR LEKAR GODI ME
english translation text: SHE TOOK THE HEAD IN HER LAPS AND STARTED WEEPING

arabic text: BABA DEKHO, AANKHEN KHOLO\nYEH KAUN ZAEEFA HAI
english translation text: LOOK FATHER, OPEN YOUR EYES, LOOK AT MY STATE

arabic text: MASOOM KI GARDAN ME\nBANDHI HAI RASAN AISE
english translation text: ON THE NECK OF THE INNOCENT GIRL, THEY HAVE TIED ROPES

arabic text: GHUT JAAEGA DAM ISKA\nME TEZ CHALUN KAISE
english translation text: SHE WILL SUFFOCATE LIKE THIS, HOW CAN I WALK ANY FASTER

arabic text: YEH KEHTA HUWA, BIMAR MERA\nKHAM HOKAR CHALTA HAI
english translation text: WHILST SAYING THIS, SAJJAD WOULD WALK WITH HIS BACK BROKEN

arabic text: ROZE PE NAZAR JAB BHI\nAY SHADMAN JAATI HAI
english translation text: WHENEVER WE LOOK AT HER SHRINE

arabic text: PHIR QALB E TAKALLUM KO\nYE BAAT RULAATI HAI
english translation text: THEN THE HEART ACHES, AND WE CRY

arabic text: CHOTI BIBI\nSADIYAAN GUZRI\nZINDAAN ME TANHA HAI
english translation text: IT HAS BEEN YEARS, THIS LITTLE GIRL HAS BEEN ALL ALONE IN THE PRISON

arabic text: AY SHIMR ZARA KUCH REHM TO KHA
english translation text: O SHIMR! HAVE SOME MERCY

arabic text: YE CHHOTI ZEHRA HAI\nMASOOM SAKINA HAI
english translation text: THIS IS A LITTLE ZAHRA,\nTHIS IS THE INNOCENT SAKINA

arabic text: NA MAAR ISE,\nNAAZON SE ISE SHABBIR NE PAALA HAI
english translation text: DO NOT HIT HER,\nHUSSAIN BROUGHT HER UP WITH\nSO MUCH LOVE AND CARE

arabic text: MAANGA HAI KANIZI ME,\nUS PHOOL SI BACCHI KO
english translation text: THEY HAVE ASKED FOR THIS INNOCENT GIRL AS A SLAVE

arabic text: SHEH NE APNE, SAJDON ME JISSE,\nALLAH SE MAANGA HAI
english translation text: THE SAME ONE WHO HUSSAIN PRAYED FOR IN HIS SALATUL LAYL

arabic text: PUSHTE NAAQA, PAR KYUN TANHA,\nRASSI SE BAANDHA HAI
english translation text: WHY HAVE YOU TIED HER SO AWKWARDLY\nON THE BACK OF THE CAMEL

arabic text: DIKHLA KE ISE PAANI,\nMATTI PE BAHAATA HA
english translation text: YOU TAUNT HER BY\nSHOWING HER WATER,\nTHEN SPILL IT ON THE FLOOR

arabic text: BACCHI NE KIYA NAUHA\nSAR LE KAR GODI ME,
english translation text: SHE TOOK THE HEAD\nINTO HER LAP AND WAILED

arabic text: AANKHEIN KHOLO, BABA DEKHO,\nYE KAUN ZA'IFA HAI
english translation text: OPEN YOUR EYES,\nO BABA, LOOK AT MY STATE!

arabic text: MEIN TEZ CHALUN KAISE\nGUTH JAAYEGA DAM IS KA,
english translation text: SHE WILL LOSE HER BREATH\nLIKE THIS,\nHOW CAN I WALK

arabic text: YE KEHTA HUWA, BIMAAR MERA,\nKHAM HO KAR CHALTA HAI\nSAJJAD CRIES,
english translation text: WALKING WITH HIS BACK BENT

arabic text: TURBAT PE SAKINA KI,\nAABID NE KAHA HOGA
english translation text: SAJJAD LAMENTED AT\nTHE GRAVE OF SAKINA

arabic text: YE MERI AMAANAT HAI,\nRAKHNA TU KHAYAAL ISKA
english translation text: THIS IS MY POSSESSION,\nTAKE GOOD CARE OF HER

arabic text: BABA BHI NAHI, AMMU BHI NAHI,\nBE AAS YATIMA HAI
english translation text: NO FATHER, NO UNCLE,\nSHE IS AN ORPHAN WITH NO HOPE
